verdict.rationale: A probe confirmed that LiveKit serves an llms.txt at docs.livekit.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200) and markdown versions of its docs pages (e.g. /agents/.md). The docs also state the platform is built for coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex. Missing for 10: no evidence of the llms.txt's depth or coverage, and no hands-on report of an agent actually consuming these docs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
